full_name: Gish Jen | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Gish Jen’s stories and articles have appeared in The New Yorker, The Atlantic Monthly, The New York Times, The Los Angeles Times, and The New Republic, among other publications, and have been anthologized in numerous textbooks and collections.
